source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper introduces lm-SCMs/lm-graphs and NATE, gives Figure 3(b)'s fix-before-select recovery, and states Proposition 4 as a sufficient recovery criterion while noting that a complete combined procedure is not guaranteed.

The paper gives a sound CSI calculus and automated search, proves the general decision problem NP-hard, and does not claim general completeness.
The paper uses partial-order fixing for missing-data subproblems, provides sufficient identification characterizations, and leaves general search and completeness questions open.
The article establishes order invariance for valid fixing sequences and reachable kernels in the ordinary ADMG/CADMG nested-Markov setting.
